svg.text: Improvement 1 — Stop scattering a conversation across models
One agent conversation, five turns. Tier candidates as in docs/hybrid-router.md: SIMPLE/MEDIUM → llama-3-1-8b or qwen3-coder-30b · COMPLEX → qwen3-coder-30b.
A · TODAY — the router decides every request from ALL user messages joined together (custom_hybrid_router.py:153 → hybrid_router.py:136)
Result: 3 model changes in 4 steps → 3 extra re-reads; a 30B model answers “thanks”; the bandit's latency mixes warm and cold turns (it partly learns cache luck).
B · AFTER — classify the NEWEST turn, keep a session tier that only goes up, stay on the pinned model while it can serve that tier
Result: 1 model change (a deliberate escalation) → 1 re-read; the bandit learns only from like-for-like turns (step 4).
2 Classify the NEWEST user turn → turn_tier
pin the new model · switched = true
this latency includes a cold re-read
NO → update bandit with the reward
D · Step 1 (measure first) and Step 5 (play to Xeon's strengths)
Step 1 — Measure first: a go / no-go gate ⚠️
switch rate = turns whose model ≠ previous turn's model ÷ all turns
penalty = median TTFT(switched turns) − median TTFT(stayed turns)
daily waste ≈ switch rate × penalty × turns per day
Small → stop here (don't build steps 2–4). Large → build them.
Needs session_id in request metadata → visible in Langfuse traces.
a · Keep KV caches longer (big DRAM, 📚 CXL)
GPU memory is tens–hundreds of GB; a Xeon server has terabytes of DRAM.
Longer-lived caches → resumed sessions and repeated system prompts stay warm.
Turn Xeon's capacity into fewer re-reads, the step CPUs find most expensive.
b · Quantised agent models, behind an accuracy gate
int8 / int4 weights → fewer bytes read per token → faster generation.
Gate: ship only if tool-call JSON validity and task success match bf16.
Catalog already supports AWQ and OpenVINO int4 (models.yaml:103, :109).
c · Keep sandboxes on separate machines
CPU pinning separates cores, NOT shared cache and memory bandwidth.
A busy sandbox can slow token generation on the same socket.
First: nodeSelector for sandboxes. Intel RDT only if they must share.
Today's behaviour from enterprise-inference@723fe6e: custom_hybrid_router.py:153,157,162 · hybrid_router.py:136,206,234–236 · models.yaml:416 (prefix caching on). Drawn for study.
